snippet_primary: "I want to report my extremely disappointing experiences with Etsy. 1. I purchased a \"Winter\" set including hand gloves, a scarf, and a hat, which was advertised as cashmere but was not. I had to return it. 2. I also purchased items with \"sapphire\" glass stones sold as genuine sapphires, which they clearly were not. Etsy allows sellers to mislead buyers and ignores legitimate complaints. Because of this, I have closed my account and will no longer shop on Etsy."
subject_exact: buyer-reported misdescribed materials in two purchases (non-cashmere winter set, glass stones sold as sapphires), unaddressed complaints, and account closure
local_qualifiers: which was advertised as cashmere but was not
sold as genuine sapphires, which they clearly were not
